analytics.raw_text: Raman. Table 1 (printed Tabelle 1) gives the band maxima of the Raman spectrum of crystal modification I in [cm-1]: 60 values, from 91 to 3075. Lines 97 to 138 with the continuation at 185 to 190. The full list is in the source and is not repeated here. The enum has no Raman value, so method is other and Raman is named in this text.

notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is not a distinct chemical entity, it is crystal modification I of tembotrione. Table 1 is analytical data only. The Raman band list is the section's whole content for this modification; the caption and the column header name it, and nothing here is a synthesis. The wavenumbers are measurements, not compounds.
